reuse.why: Calls the existing shared getScheduledAmount helper with the raw schedule amount instead of re-deriving the missing/number/range rule.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the field is a single call to the shared helper.

placement.why: The output field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal and the APIScheduleEntity type in api-models.ts, where the API shapes schedules.

scope.why: Only the type field, the mapping line, the import and a release note are added.

maintainability.why: A minimal change that keeps the expected-amount rule in one shared definition.
